status: DRAFT for Greg (2026-09-29): written from the rules already in the classroom code and Greg's standing rules; Greg adds or cuts. Not yet loaded by any code.
purpose: The one place the classroom rules live. The classroom code is to load this file and hold every answer, teacher reading and correction to it; Frankie's analysis cites it. Each rule names where it came from.

seats.frankie: the learner: his code, calculations and brain; his findings are claims
seats.boss_teacher: the original BOSS teacher: mathematics, representation supervision, targets, masks and controls, plus scientific research; code
seats.scientific_teacher: mechanism and evidence; tests every claim as a hypothesis with its own chance check (SPEC-scientific-teacher.md)

rules.rule: Observation, interpretation and hypothesis stay distinct. A state or value is an observation; its market meaning is interpretation; an unsupported developing structure is labelled HYPOTHESIS.
No future-outcome claim. Nothing in the classroom states or implies a later outcome; future_outcome_claimed is false in every answer and finding.

Complete coverage: all 19 dimensions in governed order, every retained cursor accounted for, all 171 pairs considered. Nothing is skipped because it is repetitive, neutral, missing, invalid or ablated.
rules.source: dipole_classroom.py:10 (complete Dipole coverage is invariant), :409; dipole_classroom_final_review.py:454

rules.rule: Zero data dropped: no caps, no truncation, nothing normalized or averaged. Unknown or incomplete data is listed, never dropped or filled in.

Counts, never averages as findings. A correlation, an R2 and a fitted slope are averages; they may be reported beside the counts, never in place of them. Results are per cell and per day, never pooled.
rules.source: CLAUDE.md D37 and the trading rules (per cell always, never pool); research/kalshi/per_event.py

rules.rule: A novel finding is never an error for being new. It is kept as a hypothesis with its evidence cited, tracked for reproduction in later causally available windows, and never promoted into the curriculum on one appearance.

Corrections are specific: where a claim differs, the wording is 'the data is showing this instead', naming the values or states. Only the contradicted subclaim changes; a broader premise that is not itself contradicted stays.
Resolve every correction id in your own words (a bare id echo is not a resolution) and state any remaining disagreement explicitly.
The teachers see all the data except how Frankie makes decisions: his decision process is withheld.
Graded outcomes are kept out of the lesson material. The next cycle carries WHERE Frankie was corrected, never the answer key or the exhaustive grade.
Frankie's findings, his independent and novel ones included, reach both teachers as claims, never as truth, labelled as his.

The two teachers are tied together and keep their separate roles. The BOSS teacher hands over what it measured; the scientific teacher hands back its test results, challenges and proposed tests; each turn builds on the other's; a new discovery from the exchange is recorded as the teachers' own finding.
rules.source: DROP_IN_20260928_GRANITE_DECOUPLE.md, The two teachers are TIED TOGETHER; dipole_teacher_discussion.py (roles boss_teacher_scientific, scientific_teacher)

rules.rule: Nothing is dropped early. An early negative (one window, one day, one cell) is a scoped finding with its data named; a path is set aside only at the end of all research runs on the historical data. Dipole direction is open research.
A disposition word (supported, contradicted, unresolved, insufficient) is orientation only. The finding is what the test measured: its counts, cells and days, stated as what the data is showing.
rules.source: Greg's standing preference (outcomes open-ended, never a binary); dipole_scientific_review.py DISPOSITIONS

rules.rule: Discovery days only. The classroom and both teachers work on discovery days; confirmation days stay untouched by the classroom, the teachers and Frankie until the survivor list is frozen.
Duplicate data declines the run, with the reason.
No model voice in the classroom: Granite has nothing to do with the classroom. Every seat's output comes from code, calculations or a measured test.

open_for_greg: R05 vs the current grading key: the classroom still grades the 171 pairs with pooled Pearson (dipole_classroom.py:408, minimum overlap). D37 counts a correlation as an average. Replacing the pooled Pearson pairs re-mints the grading (an open call carried in the drop-in).
Anything to add or cut. This draft only gathers rules that already exist.
